data.title: PSG vs Roma: Champions League preview, prediction, team news, and info
data.content:
AS Roma have injury problems of their own. Devyne Rensch (adductor) and Leonardo Balerdi (ankle) joined Lorenzo Pellegrini (thigh) on the treatment table.

## Paris Saint Germain possible starting lineup:

Safonov; Hakimi, Marquinhos, Pacho, Mendes; Zaire-Emery, Vitinha, Ruiz; Akliouche, Dembele, Mayulu.

## AS Roma possible starting lineup:

Svilar; Mancini, Ndicka, Hermoso; Molina, Cristante, Kone, Wesley; Soule, Mora; Malen.

Prediction: PSG 3-2 Roma [...] ## Paris Saint Germain team news:

The big news from the weekend was that Doué picked up an ACL injury against Nice, so he will join Khvicha (ACL) on the treatment table. This is problematic, as these two wingers performed really well in the Champions League for the French side. The club will now think about signing a new winger this winter.

## AS Roma team news: [...] I Giallorossi head into this game full of confidence after dispatching Parma 1-5 on the road. This result is no surprise, as Parma is near the bottom and Roma are currently second, fighting for the title. It remains to be seen whether the club from Italy's capital can sustain their domestic form for the rest of the season as Inter, AC Milan and Juventus are no pushovers. Despite being rocked by recent injuries to Désiré Doué and Khvicha, Luis Enrique's side will come into this clash confident

## Team News

Further diminishing PSG's talented front line, Doue must join Khvicha Kvaratskhelia on the long road to recovery from an ACL injury.

More positively for Luis Enrique - a former Roma coach - Ousmane Dembele recently made his comeback from a layoff.

Fabian Ruiz has posted goal involvements in all of his last four Champions League appearances, scoring in the last two, and he should start in central midfield. [...] Club captain Marquinhos moved to Paris from Roma in 2013, while reserve left-back Lucas Digne spent the 2015-16 campaign on loan with the Giallorossi.

Roma welcomed back Paulo Dybala and first-choice goalkeeper Mile Svilar during the international break, but Lorenzo Pellegrini is still unavailable.

Devyne Rensch (adductor) and Leonardo Balerdi (ankle) are both struggling to recover in time for Wednesday's game.

data.content:
PSG will be without Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Desire Doue, who are both recovering from serious knee injuries. Ousmane Dembele has returned to action after overcoming his fitness problems and should reclaim his place in the starting lineup. Fabian Ruiz is also expected to feature from the beginning after registering goal contributions in each of his last four Champions League appearances. Meanwhile, captain Marquinhos and Nuno Mendes have regained full fitness and should start. [...] As for Roma, Paulo Dybala and first-choice goalkeeper Mile Svilar have returned to contention after overcoming their respective fitness problems. However, Lorenzo Pellegrini remains sidelined, while Devyne Rensch and Leonardo Balerdi are struggling to recover in time for Wednesday's clash. Brazilian wing-back Wesley is expected to return to the starting lineup after producing three assists against Parma, while Malen should lead the line following his four-goal haul.
